metadata.description: Postemi (postemi.com) plugins: the MCP connector for chat, the CLI for coding agents, and the optional growth skill.

plugins.name: postemi
plugins.description: Social media scheduler for Claude: write, schedule and publish posts to 37 platforms and apps, including Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest and Mastodon, with a content calendar and photo and video uploads in full quality. Browser sign-in, no key.

plugins.name: postemi-cli
plugins.description: Postemi CLI for coding agents: the postemi command line tool and its full reference, for scheduling and publishing social posts from a terminal, a script or an agent with a shell (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes).

plugins.name: postemi-growth
plugins.description: Optional Postemi skill: grow an audience on social media. Choosing networks and a first niche, a 30-day posting test, cadence per network, reading the numbers, 30 post angles for one topic, repurposing, bios and profile links, and a weekly review. Install it next to the Postemi plugin (MCP or CLI), which schedules the posts.
